The references to `getUserByUuid` in the REST module fall into five production call sites, plus test-only usages. I'm citing the five production declarations below; the test usages are listed in prose only.

**Production code that calls `UserService.getUserByUuid`** (best first):

1. **`UserResource1_8.getByUniqueId`** (`omod/src/main/java/.../resource/openmrs1_8/UserResource1_8.java:208-211`). This is the main REST user lookup. It returns `UserAndPassword1_8` or null, so a change in null-handling or retirement semantics would show up in `GET /user/{uuid}`.
2. **`UserConverter1_8.getByUniqueId`** (`omod/src/main/java/.../converter/openmrs1_8/UserConverter1_8.java:35-37`). This is the converter used when a `User` is referenced by UUID in request bodies, so any behaviour change affects every resource that accepts a user reference.
3. **`ProviderSearchHandler1_9.search`** (`omod/src/main/java/.../search/openmrs1_9/ProviderSearchHandler1_9.java:53-64`). It resolves the `user` request parameter to a `User`, then looks up providers by that person. An empty-result path depends on `null` for unknown UUIDs.
4. **`AlertRecipientResource2_0.setRecipientProperty`** (`omod/src/main/java/.../resource/openmrs2_0/AlertRecipientResource2_0.java:85-93`). It resolves the recipient UUID and silently skips the assignment when the result is null.
5. **`ChangePasswordController1_8.changeOthersPassword`** (`omod/src/main/java/.../controller/openmrs1_8/ChangePasswordController1_8.java:69-85`). It looks up the target user under a proxy privilege and throws `NullPointerException` when the result is null or unsaved, so a change in the not-found contract would alter this endpoint's behaviour.

**Test code that also calls it** (not cited in the JSON, because I did not bound the individual test methods): `UserResource2_0Test`, `UserResource1_9Test`, `AlertResource2_0Test`, `UserController1_8Test`, `UserController2_0Test`, `AlertController2_0Test`, `AlertRecipientResource2_0Test`, `PasswordResetController2_2Test`, `AlertRecipientController2_0Test` and `ChangePasswordController1_8Test`, all under `omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/`. These would need updating if the contract changed, but they are not production behaviour.

Two notes on the search. The repository is registered as `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-module-webservices.rest`, so my first two calls under the short name failed. I did not check `openmrs-core` itself, so I have not confirmed how `UserService.getUserByUuid` is implemented. I made no file changes.
